output.title: HTTP01 Ingress pathType switch to Exact may affect challenges
output.content: The Ingress pathType cert-manager uses changes from ImplementationSpecific to Exact. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources and sets global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, but the summary does not show whether Ingress-based HTTP01 solving is in use. Inspect your issuers for Ingress HTTP01 solvers, the value of global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, and your Ingress controller's handling of pathType Exact.
